---
title: "National Inpatient Sample Study"
params:
  data_path: null
  years: [2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022]
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
# The survey design is cached. To force a full re-run, delete the
# analysis_cache folder next to this file.
library(easyNIS)
library(purrr)
library(srvyr)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust", survey.adjust.domain.lonely = TRUE)
gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal("jama")

is_example <- is.null(params$data_path)
input_path <- if (is_example) {
  nis_example(years = params$years)
} else {
  params$data_path
}

opened <- nis_open(input_path, years = params$years)
nis_data <- opened
data_files <- easyNIS:::nis_open_source_paths(opened)
```

## Study definitions

```{r}
#| label: definitions
codes <- list(
  principal_dx = c("I50"),
  exposure = c("Z515")
)
cohort <- rlang::expr(principal_dx & AGE >= 18)
annualize <- FALSE

nis_data <- nis_data |>
  nis_flag_dx(principal_dx = codes$principal_dx, position = "principal") |>
  nis_flag_dx(exposed = codes$exposure, position = "any")

# Quarto can put chunk options in HTML attributes, so pass hashes to the renderer.
# Changes made by sourced scripts or mutable environment state need an explicit
# cache input or a fresh render without the saved cache.
design_key <- rlang::hash(easyNIS:::nis_study_cache_key(
  input_path = input_path,
  is_example = is_example,
  data_files = data_files,
  years = params$years,
  codes = codes,
  cohort = rlang::expr_text(cohort),
  annualize = annualize,
  source_chunks = list(
    setup = knitr::knit_code$get("setup"),
    definitions = knitr::knit_code$get("definitions")
  ),
  survey_options = list(
    lonely_psu = getOption("survey.lonely.psu"),
    adjust_domain_lonely = getOption("survey.adjust.domain.lonely")
  )
))
```

```{r}
#| label: design
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr design_key
study_design <- rlang::inject(
  nis_design(
    nis_data,
    !!cohort,
    keep = c(
      AGE, FEMALE, DIED, LOS, TOTCHG, CCR_NIS,
      principal_dx, exposed, dplyr::any_of("DQTR")
    ),
    annualize = annualize,
    dollars = max(params$years)
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: report-definitions
exposure <- "exposed"
covariates <- c(
  "AGE", "FEMALE",
  if (length(params$years) > 1L) "factor(YEAR)"
)
outcomes <- dplyr::tibble(
  outcome = c("DIED", "LOS", "cost_adj"),
  family = c("quasibinomial", "gaussian", "gaussian"),
  exponentiate = c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
)
```

```{r}
#| label: design-summary
disclosure_limit <- 10L
# All report estimates and disclosure checks use this analysis domain.
analysis <- easyNIS:::nis_study_analysis_domain(study_design, exposure, disclosure_limit)
analysis_design <- analysis$design
has_exposure_comparison <- analysis$comparison
exposure_restricted <- analysis$restricted
records <- analysis_design$variables
cohort_n <- nrow(records)
has_cohort <- cohort_n > 0L
formulas <- lapply(outcomes$outcome, stats::reformulate, termlabels = c(exposure, covariates))
report_variables <- unique(c(exposure, "AGE", "FEMALE", "DIED", "LOS", "cost_adj", unlist(lapply(formulas, all.vars))))
support <- easyNIS:::nis_study_report_support(
  records, report_variables, if (analysis$safe) exposure, disclosure_limit
)
pooled_mask <- support$pooled
outcome_ok <- support$variables[intersect(c("DIED", "LOS", "cost_adj"), names(support$variables))]
study_header <- function(table) easyNIS:::nis_study_header(table, analysis)
report <- easyNIS:::nis_study_reporting(opened, analysis_design, params$years)
table_one <- outcome_table <- trend_estimates <- NULL
render_table <- function(table) {
  easyNIS:::nis_study_render_table(table, html = knitr::is_html_output())
}
```

## Methods

```{r}
#| label: generated-methods
#| results: asis
# Edit the generated text here or copy it from the report into your manuscript.
cat(easyNIS:::nis_study_methods(report, is_example), "\n")
```

`r if (exposure_restricted) "The report uses discharges with observed exposure."`

The placeholder-row design and cost adjustment are experimental pending
scientific approval.

**Cells based on ≤`r disclosure_limit` unweighted discharges are masked. The report also masks cells with fewer than two contributing hospitals and may mask related figures. Review tables for other derivable cells before sharing under the HCUP Data Use Agreement. Review cross-classified releases separately under the agreement, including combinations that can reveal cells when weights are constant within a year. Review coding-era presence reported in Methods or the checklist before sharing.**

## Cohort flow

`r if (exposure_restricted) "The flow table shows the final reporting cohort." else "The flow follows the analysis input through the principal diagnosis flag, the cohort criterion, and the survey design’s eligibility checks."`
Weighted flow totals sum unscaled discharge weights from valid-design records.

```{r}
#| label: flow
flow_display <- rlang::inject(easyNIS:::nis_study_flow(
  nis_data, principal_dx, !!cohort, analysis_design, pooled_mask, disclosure_limit,
  exposure_restricted = exposure_restricted
))
render_table(flow_display)
```

## Table 1

Brackets show the unweighted count used for a continuous summary or the
unweighted cell count and observed denominator for a categorical percentage.

```{r}
#| label: table-one
if (!has_cohort) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Table 1 is unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design."
  )
} else if (nzchar(pooled_mask) || (has_exposure_comparison && !support$by_arm)) {
  knitr::asis_output("Table 1 is withheld under the study disclosure policy.")
} else {
  variables <- c("AGE", "FEMALE", names(outcome_ok)[outcome_ok])
  baseline_statistics <- list(
    gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75}) [{N_nonmiss_unweighted}]",
    gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%) [{n_unweighted}/{N_unweighted}]"
  )
  table_one <- if (support$by_arm) {
    gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
      analysis_design,
      by = dplyr::all_of(exposure),
      include = dplyr::all_of(variables),
      label = FEMALE ~ "Female",
      statistic = baseline_statistics,
      missing_stat = "{N_miss_unweighted}",
      type = list(dplyr::any_of(c("AGE", "LOS", "cost_adj")) ~ "continuous")
    ) |>
      gtsummary::add_p() |>
      gtsummary::add_overall()
  } else {
    gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
      analysis_design,
      include = dplyr::all_of(variables),
      label = FEMALE ~ "Female",
      statistic = baseline_statistics,
      missing_stat = "{N_miss_unweighted}",
      type = list(dplyr::any_of(c("AGE", "LOS", "cost_adj")) ~ "continuous")
    )
  }

  table_one <- easyNIS:::nis_study_summary_table(table_one, support$variables, disclosure_limit, study_header)
  render_table(table_one)
}
```

## Outcomes

```{r}
#| label: outcomes
if (!has_cohort) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Outcome summaries are unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design."
  )
} else if (nzchar(pooled_mask) || !any(outcome_ok)) {
  knitr::asis_output("Outcome summaries are withheld under the study disclosure policy.")
} else {
  outcome_table <- gtsummary::tbl_svysummary(
    analysis_design,
    include = dplyr::all_of(names(outcome_ok)[outcome_ok]),
    type = list(dplyr::any_of(c("LOS", "cost_adj")) ~ "continuous"),
    statistic = list(gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})")
  )

  outcome_table <- easyNIS:::nis_study_summary_table(outcome_table, support$variables, disclosure_limit, study_header)
  render_table(outcome_table)
}
```

## Trends by year

The chart and table mask yearly figures with insufficient discharge or hospital
support. Each point shows the unweighted number of discharges with an observed
outcome. The bars show 95% confidence intervals.

```{r}
#| label: trends
if (!has_cohort) {
  knitr::asis_output(
    "Trends are unavailable because the cohort has no rows in the survey design."
  )
} else {
trend_estimates <- easyNIS:::nis_study_trend_estimates(analysis_design)
trend <- dplyr::left_join(trend_estimates, support$by_year, by = "YEAR") |>
  dplyr::rename(mortality_ok = DIED, los_ok = LOS)
trend_masks <- easyNIS:::nis_study_trend_masks(trend)

trend_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  trend |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR, measure = "In-hospital mortality",
      estimate = mortality, lower = mortality_low, upper = mortality_upp,
      n = DIED_n,
      visible = !nzchar(.env$trend_masks$mortality)
    ),
  trend |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      YEAR, measure = "Mean length of stay",
      estimate = mean_los, lower = mean_los_low, upper = mean_los_upp,
      n = LOS_n,
      visible = !nzchar(.env$trend_masks$los)
    )
) |>
  dplyr::filter(visible)

if (nrow(trend_long)) print(ggplot2::ggplot(
  trend_long,
  ggplot2::aes(x = YEAR, y = estimate, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(width = 0.15) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(y = upper, label = paste0("n = ", n)), vjust = -0.6, size = 3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~measure, scales = "free_y") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = params$years) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Discharge year", y = "Survey estimate") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal())

render_table(easyNIS:::nis_study_trend_table(trend, trend_masks))
}
```

## Multivariable models

Models use the exposure and covariates declared above. A model is shown only
when the reporting cohort has complete model data and the fitted estimates
are finite and usable. Each model heading gives its fitted unweighted sample size. A valid
model with a design warning remains visible, with that warning shown below.
Unavailable models include the reason; the declared model specification is
not changed to make a model fit.

```{r}
#| label: models
model_results <- purrr::map(seq_len(nrow(outcomes)), function(i) {
  current <- outcomes[i, ]
  outcome <- current$outcome[[1L]]
  formula <- formulas[[i]]
  model_variables <- intersect(all.vars(formula), names(support$variables))
  report_supported <- !nzchar(pooled_mask) &&
    (!has_exposure_comparison || support$by_arm) && all(support$variables[model_variables])
  model_family <- switch(
    current$family[[1L]],
    quasibinomial = stats::quasibinomial(),
    gaussian = stats::gaussian()
  )
  easyNIS:::nis_study_fit_report_model(
    formula,
    design = analysis_design,
    family = model_family,
    outcome = outcome,
    exposure = exposure,
    disclosure_limit = disclosure_limit,
    report_supported = report_supported
  )
})

valid_models <- which(vapply(model_results, function(result) {
  !is.null(result$model)
}, logical(1)))
family_rows <- split(valid_models, outcomes$family[valid_models])
family_tables <- purrr::map(family_rows, function(rows) {
  easyNIS:::nis_study_model_table(model_results[rows], outcomes[rows, ])
})

model_notes <- purrr::map_chr(seq_along(model_results), function(i) {
  result <- model_results[[i]]
  outcome <- outcomes$outcome[[i]]
  if (!is.null(result$status)) {
    return(paste0("**", outcome, " unavailable:** ", result$status))
  }
  if (length(result$warnings) > 0L) {
    return(paste0(
      "**", outcome, " model warning:** ",
      paste(unique(result$warnings), collapse = "; ")
    ))
  }
  ""
})
```

```{r}
#| label: model-tables
rendered_tables <- purrr::map_chr(family_tables, function(family_table) {
  table <- render_table(family_table)
  rendered <- knitr::knit_print(table)
  metadata <- attr(rendered, "knit_meta", exact = TRUE)
  if (length(metadata) > 0L) {
    knitr::knit_meta_add(metadata)
  }
  as.character(rendered)
})
model_output <- c(model_notes[nzchar(model_notes)], rendered_tables)
if (length(model_output) == 0L) {
  knitr::asis_output("No model tables or model status messages were produced.")
} else {
  knitr::asis_output(paste(model_output, collapse = "\n\n"))
}
```

## Checklist receipt

The receipt covers the generated report and follows the
[HCUP NIS checklist](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/db/nation/nis/nischecklist.jsp)
and [Khera et al.](https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2017.17653).
The receipt marks manuscript and clinical checks “Analyst review.”
Review the finished outputs under the
[HCUP Data Use Agreement](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/team/NationwideDUA.pdf).
After rendering, stage only the files you intend to publish in a separate
folder, then run `easyNIS::nis_scan_outputs("path/to/public-outputs", error = TRUE)`.
Review the findings and check manually for counts that readers could
recover from related tables, figures, or other releases.

```{r}
#| label: checklist-receipt
receipt <- easyNIS:::nis_study_checklist(
  report, list(table_one, outcome_table), purrr::map(model_results[valid_models], "model"),
  trend_estimates, analysis_design
)
knitr::kable(receipt)
```
